profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
SUMMARY:

Software engineer focused in every stage of product lifecycle: architecture, design, development, and finally continuous integration along with delivery and deployment. Always working towards customer satisfaction. 

COMPUTING AND COMMON SKILLS
===================================

System Administration Skills
-----------------------------------------------
Both Windows and Unix (Linux) systems administration


Programming Skills and Experience in:
--------------------------------------------------------
> Java SE, Java Enterprise (J2EE)
> NET Framework: C#, Visual Basic, ASP.NET, etc.
> C language programing and structured programming paradigm.
> Shell Bash scripting languages.
> DBMS procedural languages: mainly Oracle's PL/SQL Language.
> Web programming skills using JavaScript and JQuery.


Database Management Systems Skills:
-----------------------------------------------------------------
> Oracle: SQL queries, PL/SQL code, triggers, stored procedures, etc.
> MySQL DBMS
> SQL Server DBMS
> PostgreSQL DBMS
> Firebird RDBMS


Web Services Skills
------------------------------
> RESTful and SOAP web services paradigm.
> Application Servers such as Apache Tomcat y Glassfish

Networking Skills
-------------------------------
> TCP / IP and LAN Networks administration, design and deployment
> Network troubleshooting
> Routing protocols understanding
> Network Services: FTP, HTTP, DHCP, et all.

SW Project Management Skills:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> Agile software development techniques (Scrum).
> Revision control systems: Git, Subversion, Plastic SCM.
> Revision control software client applications: TortoiseGIT, TortoiseSVN.
> Experience with software repositories: Github.
> Project Dependecies management: MAVEN Tool, XP-DEV Tool



SW Development Seminars
----------------------------------------
- Application Monitoring and Profiling Techniques using Java language organized by Arcadia Consulting Software Company

positions.description:
-Design and implementation of asset tracking & serialization technologies servicing multiple customers from diverse economic sectors and industries.
-Customer Systems integration under different software interfaces.
-Delivery focused
-Customer orientation
-Azure Cloud & DevOps delivery pipelining
-Microservices and DS architecturing

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Mobility solutions focused in health monitoring and contact tracing system for COVID19 security health guidelines implementation using DP3T protocol.
- Handheld app implementation on Android Platform for employees with security passport indicating health employee status according to body temperature records.
- Data persistence implementation under embedded database system SQLite.
- Rest API integration
- Additional tools & technologies: SCRUM, Azure DevOps, Microsoft AppCenter

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- (Returnable and Non-Returnable) Asset tracking solutions analysis and new features development
- Mobility solutions processes enhancement on Android platform developed with Xamarin Framework under (.Net Framework), C# & WebAPI technologies.
- Data Persistence implementation under Oracle Database (PL/SQL) & Ms SQL Server.
- Agile Methodologies employed: SCRUM, Atlassian Jira & Azure DevOps tools.

positions.title: Software Developer & Analyst
positions.description: CIRCE Project for Small And Medium Sized Enterprises creation and Registration sponsored by Ministry of Economy.

company.name: Ministerio de Economía, Industria y Competitividad

positions.title: Software Developer & Analyst
positions.description:
Design and development of Applications Suite for water processes management (water supply processes, sanitary works, assets logging, stocks and inventory, vehicles fleets tracking).
Web client developed using JavaScript and many related frontend language libraries and tools such as jQuery, FontAwesome, Dojo Toolkit, RequireJs, MomentJs, SyncFusion Toolkit Widgets and Components, RealTime WebSockets (SignalR).
HTML and CSS for markup, layout and styling.
Backend and RESTful API using C# Net Framework WCF Services. LinQ.
Service Oriented Arquitecture (SOA) and Middleware layered platforms for system escalation.
Additional Tools and Technologies: 
SQL-Server Database Management (T-SQL)
Team Foundation Server (TFS) for Revision Control System
Use of Agile methodologies like SCRUM for process and software design including development with tools such as Atlassian JIRA, Trello, MeisterTask

company.name: Gestión y Técnicas del Agua S.A. (Gestagua)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Mobile Apps development focused in Cleaning Services Management and Scheduling developed under Android O.S. with Java as programming language.
-Implementation and Enhancement of RESTful Web Services in order to enable and improve communication between mobile devices and central servers storing all the relevant data.
-Data persistence administration tasks performed with DBMS Microsoft SQL Server 2008 R2

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Distributed and Integrated System development on Medical Emergencies Attendance, hospitalized patients and Small-to-medium medical centers management.
-The system is divided into 2 software components: Mobile Device and Centralized Server running Web services.
-Mobile component: mobile app developed under Android O.S. and SDK platform using Java.
-Central Server component: running Web Services implemented under REST paradigm and developed with Spring Framework in J2EE. Deployment made on Apache Tomcat Server.
-Additional Tools/Technologies used: Eclipse IDE, Hibernate ORM Mapping Tool, Maven Dependency Management Tool, Selenium IDE Testing Tool, others...
-Requirements gathering and analysis assisted and supported by specialized medical staff.
-Relational data model design and implementation using MySQL DBMS.
-Project executed in bilateral agreement and collaboration between Hewlett-Packard Spain and University of Burgos.

positions.title: Software Developer (Web, Desktop, Mobile)
positions.description:
-Mobile Apps development focused in Coffee Delivery Businesses implemented in Android SDK Platform
-Ordinary Web Development tasks using (CSS, XML, HTML) and CMS-oriented web development with Joomla CMS
-Software requirements gathering, planning, development, implementation and finally deployment in customer premises.
-NET Framework application development
-General Java Applications development with Eclipse IDE

positions.title: Computer Systems Administration
positions.description:
-Computer Systems Facilities administration and maintenance
-TCP/IP LAN Networks administration
-User Helpdesk support
-Web contents updates using customized content managers from the organization.
